646:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, how admirable you were facing that great evil of the universe, $$勝平$$! I, $$ＡＧ$$... was so moved I was lost for words!」

646:t_10:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Really? Then why don't you try fighting, too?」

646:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even if you say that, $$バンドック$$ no longer exists...」

646:t_10:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$バンドック$$ might be gone, but this guy's here! $$千代錦$$, take him on!」

646:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah! This isn't $$バンドック$$, it's a woof-dog!」

646:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Eeek! D-drool is soaking my lovable body!」

646:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, $$ゼウス$$! Welcome to these cramped quarters!」

646:t_10:22.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Dispense with the formal greetings. As of today, I am one of your comrades.」

646:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then you know what to do, don't you?」

646:t_10:24.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Indeed... A newcomer must follow your customs.」

646:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! Thank you for that powerful call!」

646:t_10:28.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now, to the point. What... are you?」

646:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe I've answered before: I'm an agent robot for $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$...」

646:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though I suppose that answer won't work on you.」

646:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please stop right there. I... don't like other people saying what I am.」

646:t_10:33.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「...Understood. I apologize for my rudeness.」

646:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As long as you understand. I apologize for being selfish, too.」

646:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But I really can't stand having some 'god' throw their weight around...)

647:t_000:2.en:
$$渓$$
「It feels like the galactic center we visited before, but...」

647:t_000:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. We're approximately 1,000 light-years from the galaxy's central point.」

647:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've also confirmed that all ships except the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ are safe within a 2,000-kilometer radius.」

647:t_000:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's a relief for now.」

647:t_000:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. At this distance, we can reunite quickly...」

647:t_000:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And I believe we can reach the galaxy's central point with a few hyperspace jumps.」

647:t_000:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「The problem will be attacks from the $$御使い$$s.」

647:t_000:9.en:
$$桂$$
「I never imagined they'd attack us in hyperspace.」

647:t_000:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「With their supernatural power, that much must be routine for them.」

647:t_000:14.en:
$n
「So much has happened, and I haven't sorted it all out yet, but the situation is simpler now.」

647:t_000:15.en:
$n
「The enemies we must defeat are called the $$御使い$$s... And $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was one of them... That's all there is to it.」

647:t_000:16.en:
$n
(Dad, Sis... and Mom... I'll do it, even if it costs me my life...)

647:t_000:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「However powerful the $$御使い$$s are, Earth is protected by $$スヴェル$$. Now we just have to take them down.」

647:t_000:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But we know far too little about the $$御使い$$s.」

647:t_000:20.en:
$$タケル$$
「Higher-dimensional life-forms... Beings above $$サイデリアル$$ who manage humanity's evolution... Beings who wield $$次元力$$ and can destroy even galaxies...」

647:t_000:21.en:
$$隼人$$
「From what $$ハーデス$$, $$ズール$$ and the others said, they also oppose those villains who call themselves gods, and seem even more powerful.」

647:t_000:22.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Thanks to the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, we know the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest is at the galaxy's central point, but we don't even know where those beings are...」

647:t_000:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「But they know what we're doing. At this rate, we'll just keep taking one-sided attacks.」

647:t_000:24.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And... Earth isn't completely guaranteed to be safe, either...」

647:t_000:25.en:
$$シン$$
「It's all right, $$セツコ$$. Earth is protected by $$スヴェル$$.」

647:t_000:26.en:
$$キラ$$
「But... if the Milky Way itself is destroyed, I can't imagine Earth would survive...」

647:t_000:27.en:
$$葵$$
「You mean that galaxy-destroying power they showed us...」

647:t_000:28.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Quite a demonstration. They destroyed an entire galaxy just to show off their power...」

647:t_000:29.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If they use that power... on the galaxy we're in...」

647:t_000:30.en:
$$勝平$$
「No matter how strong that $$スヴェル$$ thing is, it couldn't stop that...」

647:t_000:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We'll be all right... for now, at least.」

647:t_000:33.en:
$$トライア$$
「If they could use that kind of power, they'd have destroyed the galaxy... or at least Earth, long ago.」

647:t_000:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But they haven't actually done it... We should take that as evidence that there's a reason they can't destroy this galaxy.」

647:t_000:35.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They said the 'preparations were complete.' In other words, those preparations probably aren't complete for destroying this galaxy or Earth.」

647:t_000:38.en:
$$トライア$$
「And if we don't know, there's no point dwelling on it. For now, we'll just keep heading for the galaxy's central point.」

647:t_000:39.en:
$$渓$$
「Let's hurry. The new Buster Machine No. 3 is moving toward the central point separately from us, too.」

647:t_000:40.en:
$$凱$$
「Yeah! Let's meet up with the $$クォーター$$ there and smash the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

647:t_000:41.en:
$$號$$
「And it looks like someone who wants to stop us from getting there has arrived...!」

647:t_001:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「We head into the galaxy, and there's a welcoming party right away!」

647:t_001:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Units that are ready will launch first! Hurry!」

647:t_002:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We welcome your breaking through the $$御使い$$s' trap and venturing into the heart of the galaxy!」

647:t_002:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Come at us! We came prepared to fight you, too!」

647:t_002:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Do not be hasty, Earthlings. We have not come here to fight.」

647:t_002:6.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Earthlings, we acknowledge your strength. Let us join hands now and fight $$バアル$$ and the $$御使い$$s together.」

647:t_002:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You want to join forces with us?」

647:t_002:8.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That is correct, younger brothers of the galaxy. We have waited for this day.」

647:t_002:9.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Those who become higher-dimensional life-forms... gods, in other words, have a duty to guide immature species.」
